limits: The baseline actually exposed/substituted the declared callback references and returned clean on the isolated boundary. It does not show that a real V6 store or native transport was released.

The null-prototype capture protects these two private callback slots from inherited-name collisions. It does not authenticate native handles, make untrusted callbacks safe, or isolate hostile same-process code.

A callback's void return is retained as historical close-contract evidence. Later refusal cannot undo the return; no resource repair, second attempt, retry, reopen, signing or payment authority is added.

The current seven-file SDK/SQL-free graph and its current Node identity were pinned before/after. The existing 21-case harness and all old source-bound results were preserved, not upgraded by relabelling.
The 47 local cases are not the automatic hosted 27-case profile, current full native P1/P2 application proof, economic pilot or production acceptance.
